items.title: Your diplomas attached
items.body: Every document is attached to your file and opens directly for the recruiter, with no back-and-forth by email.

items.title: Your language level argued
items.body: The level is shown with what justifies it — pace, clarity, duration — instead of simply being asserted.

items.title: An attached certificate stays distinct from the estimate
items.body: If you attach a language certificate, its presence is shown separately. The attachment is not presented as authenticated by its issuer.

items.title: Your availability shown
items.body: Immediately, within 1 month or within 2 months: recruiters filter on it and won't contact you at the wrong time.

proof.title: What we can prove
proof.subtitle: No unverifiable promises. Three commitments you can hold us to.

items.title: Explicit consent
items.body: Your consent is requested before your profile becomes visible, and you can pause or withdraw it.

items.title: Contact released only on request
items.body: Your details never appear in search results. A recruiter has to ask for them, and that moment is timestamped.

items.title: Withdraw at any time
items.body: You can take your file out of the search whenever you want, without having to justify it.

faq.title: The questions everyone asks
faq.subtitle: Short answers about the capabilities available in the platform.

items.question: Does it cost anything to sign up?
items.answer: No. Creating your file is free. You pay nothing to be visible to companies.

items.question: Do you guarantee a job in Germany?
items.answer: No, and nobody can seriously guarantee that. We prepare your file and make it visible to German employers; the hiring decision is theirs.

items.question: Who sees my file?
items.answer: Companies registered on the platform, once you have accepted the terms and the processing of your data. You can withdraw your file at any time.

items.question: What happens to my phone number?
items.answer: It is used to sign you in, and it never appears in search results. A recruiter has to request your contact details explicitly, and that request is recorded.

items.question: Do I need to speak German already?
items.answer: Not to start your file. The level required depends on the trade — it is stated on each trade page — and you can keep improving while you build the file.

items.question: How long does the file take?
items.answer: You can start with your CV: it is read automatically and the extracted data remains yours to confirm or correct. Documents and the spoken assessment can come later.

items.question: Is AMUD Skills a recruitment agency?
items.answer: No. We are not a recruitment agency: we prepare your file and make it visible to German companies, who hire and decide directly.

items.question: Does AMUD Skills guarantee a job?
items.answer: No. No platform can seriously guarantee a job. We facilitate the connection; the hiring decision always belongs to the employer.

items.question: Does AMUD Skills handle my visa?
items.answer: No, not directly. Your file gathers the documents you need for your application, but the visa process itself is handled with the relevant authorities.

items.question: Who can view my documents?
items.answer: Only companies registered on the platform, once your file is visible and you have given your consent. You can pause that visibility at any time.

items.question: Can I delete my file and my data?
items.answer: Yes. You can withdraw your file from search or request deletion of your data at any time.
